get.summary: Find a property by its code
get.description: Case-insensitive. Spaces and dashes in the code are ignored, so a code read aloud and written down still matches.
Public: the account deletion page shows it, and that page must work for somebody who has already uninstalled the app.
Active leases across every property this landlord owns, so the tenant list is one request rather than one per property.
Newest first, read and unread together: what happened last week is still the answer to what happened.
Its own endpoint so drawing a badge costs one small request rather than the whole list.

get.summary: Whether this account can be closed
get.description: 204 when it can. Asked before the confirmation screen, so somebody is told why not while they can still act on it rather than after they have typed DELETE.
The written half of what unlocks on acceptance: the emergency contact and the ID number, both of which a pending request deliberately withholds. Only while the lease is active.

get.description: Says which address was invited and whether it already has a Lizmo account, so the screen knows whether to ask for a new password or the existing one.
With their property count, how many are locked, and how many slots are occupied. Counts only — no tenant is named.
Each property carries its own status, because each carries its own invoice.

delete.description: Ends every session, deletes the photographs of your ID, and removes your name, phone number and profile details. Leases and the history of what was paid stay, attached to an id that no longer names anybody, because they are your landlord's records as much as yours.
For a wrong address, or somebody who should not have been invited. The link stops working immediately.
